title: aglaia villosa

It is a small to medium-sized tree that is native to the tropical regions of Asia and the Pacific Islands. The hairy aglaia plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and boost the immune system.
